title: An entrance kit for Prairie Avenue: doors, stoops, porches and carriage doors
items: Six entrance types for the 1904 houses: a stone stoop to a panelled door, a deep round-arched doorway with double doors, curved stone steps, a timber porch, a basement area stair and a coach house's carriage doors.
Each door sits in a real opening with depth, and every stair lands level with its doorstep and stands on the ground, with equal steps.
Nothing in the kit reaches onto the public sidewalk.
No house uses the kit yet; 1808 Prairie is the first to get these entrances.
